# 25mm 3D Mink Lashes for Full, Dramatic Volume

Add bold drama to your look with these 25mm 3D faux mink lashes. Made from a newly developed fiber engineered to closely resemble real mink hair, they deliver a glossy, glamorous finish for evenings out, special occasions, or everyday glam.

## Key Features

- 25mm length for dramatic, eye-opening volume
- 3D layered design that builds a fuller, more defined look
- Soft, lightweight band that sits close to the lash line
- Slim band that blends with your natural eyeliner
- Handmade and cruelty-free
- Four styles in one pack for versatile looks

## Benefits for Your Routine

Wear them to brunch, a night out, or a photo shoot without booking a salon appointment. The lightweight, soft design keeps comfort in mind through a long day, and the variety of styles lets you move from subtle to statement in minutes. Trim them to fit your eye shape, then apply and go.

## Why Choose This Pack

Get salon-inspired volume at an affordable price, with multiple styles to experiment with. Whether you love dramatic length or want a bolder option for special nights, this pack gives you room to explore.

## Shop Now

Add these 25mm 3D mink lashes to your cart today and find your next signature look.
